title: Blur Background
about: Separate the foreground subject with a browser AI segmentation model, keep the subject sharp, and blur the remaining background.
steps: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP image up to 20 MB, or drag it into the upload area.
Review the original preview and adjust the controls available for this tool.
Run the operation and wait for the browser to finish processing.
Compare the result with the original and inspect edges or details.
Download the processed image when the preview looks correct.
capabilities: Local @imgly/background-removal segmentation creates a subject alpha mask; Canvas compositing blurs the background and restores the foreground.
benefits: This workflow can make a repetitive background and object editing task more approachable by keeping the relevant action in one place. It may be useful when preparing images for websites, forms, documents, presentations, archives, or everyday sharing, depending on the selected operation. Working from a copy is recommended whenever the original file is important. A quick review of the output helps catch quality changes, unsupported content, or formatting differences before the file is used elsewhere.
limitations: Model assets may need an internet connection on first use. Fine hair, transparent objects, low contrast, and busy scenes can produce imperfect edges.

faqs.question: What does Blur Background do?
faqs.answer: Separate the foreground subject with a browser AI segmentation model, keep the subject sharp, and blur the remaining background.

faqs.question: Are images uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: Processing runs in your browser. The AI model assets may be downloaded by the browser when first needed.

faqs.question: Will every edge be perfect?
faqs.answer: No. Inspect fine details and difficult edges in the result preview before downloading.
